company.shortDescription: Skin Smart provides a digital skincare platform that analyzes user skin profiles, lifestyle factors, and personal routines.
company.description: Skin Smart provides a digital skincare platform that analyzes user skin profiles, lifestyle factors, and personal routines to support skincare planning and product selection. The platform includes a mobile application that evaluates skin information and generates ingredient suggestions, routine guidance, and educational insights related to skincare. It also offers tools such as a skin progress journal with photo tracking, an ingredient database that explains cosmetic components, and a menstrual cycle tracker that helps users observe potential hormonal effects on skin condition.
